data.content_ref: inline:The target asserts a contradiction at the level of mechanism, but the causal claim is underspecified: the divergence at 10 pencils shows only that the bundle model imposes an integer constraint, not that the two models "contradict" in the sense required by the problem (a substantive relation naming its kind). A remainder or overbuy under a discrete constraint is a restriction, not a logical contradiction of the continuous model. The target names "contradicts" as the relation kind, yet the actual mechanism described is a domain mismatch (one model is a restriction of the other), so the causal mechanism stated does not match the relation label asserted.
